section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in a study. It describes instruments for assessing goals for exercise (EMI-2), regulation of exercise behavior (BREQ-2), and body image, which included the Physical Appearance State and Trait Anxiety Scale (PASTAS), the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and the Self-Discrepancy Index (SDI). Additionally, it outlines the assessment of physical activity using the Leisure Time Exercise Questionnaire (LTEQ) and BMI via self-reported height and weight. A correlation between weight, shape, and tone discrepancies and BAS scores was reported.
